about: Weapon operation rules and special action flags. Source: CoH3 weapon_bag.behaviour (counts over 1033 weapons in data/source/coh3) and a few other weapon_bag fields. 'use' = becomes a Burning Front weapon flag read by the named system; 'ignore' = real-time or animation detail with no meaning on a hex turn.

flags.meaning: The shot's trajectory passes over obstacles (walls, hedges, buildings, other units); no clear line of fire is needed. Mortars, artillery, grenades, rifle grenades.
Even though the weapon arcs over obstacles, it may only fire at targets its own side can see (no blind fire). Flamethrower half-tracks, some lobbed guns.
Can fire at aircraft. In Burning Front aircraft are off-map abilities: AA weapons in range of a strike's target area reduce or intercept it (rule set with the doctrine design).
AA fire is not blocked by buildings or terrain.
Range multiplier against aircraft (applies only with anti_air).
Must be EMPLACED to fire (MGs, mortars, guns).
Fires only inside the arc it was emplaced facing; turning needs packing up (SPEC §5).
Splash and stray shots also damage own units in the area.
A hit continues to the next target in line (HVAP rounds).
A miss still hits whatever stands in the shot's path (launchers).
A hit also hits everything else on the target hex.
May target an empty hex (blind barrage, suppressing an area). outside_hold_only = not while garrisoned or loaded.
Share of misses that still land and splash near the target (explosive weapons).
Aims at units inside buildings directly (no garrison cover bonus beyond the building's own).
A hit kills one model outright (sniper rifles).
An upgrade may replace this weapon (replace_weapon effect).
This weapon is the replacement an upgrade puts in.
May fire after moving this turn (with moving accuracy).
Firing reveals the unit until its next turn (SPEC §10).
